name: PyCon US Maintainer Summit
description: The PyCon US Maintainer Summit's Flashlights instance.

DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: The hostnames the portal answers on, comma-separated (the app's host, then the custom domain).

FERNET_KEY.description: Key for fields encrypted at rest. Generate one: python -c "from cryptography.fernet import Fernet; print(Fernet.generate_key().decode())"

DJANGO_DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL.description: The address the portal's email comes from.

USE_OBJECT_STORAGE.description: Uploads go to an S3-compatible bucket.

AWS_S3_ENDPOINT_URL.description: The object storage endpoint, such as https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com

SITE_DESCRIPTION.value: A gathering for open source Python maintainers at PyCon US

SITE_LOGO.description: Served by the instance from the app's static files.

SITE_FAVICON.description: Served by the instance from the app's static files.

SPONSORSHIP_ENABLED.description: false hides sponsors, tiers and donations.

STATS_PUBLIC.description: false takes the public stats pages off the site.

EXTRA_APPS.description: The community's app; the image sets it, this is the record.
